target: pre-generation added latency < 5ms preferred (offline Phase4FX measured <0.1ms; no second LLM call in production)
measurement_method: isolated microbenchmark of retriever.get_all_chunks() + select_grounded_chunks() against the real production VectorStore/Chroma collection, 5 representative queries, excluding LLM generation time entirely

per_query.query: GGとSGGの違いを初心者向けに説明して
AT-Fの性能と終了後の状態について教えて
天井は何ゲームですか
GG中とはどんな状態か教えて
ボーナス確率について教えて

assessment: 5.13ms measured vs <5ms preferred target — marginally over (about 0.13ms, ~2.6%), almost entirely attributable to the Chroma `.get()` call inside VectorStore.get_all() (title supplemental retrieval), not to select_grounded_chunks() itself (0.2ms, matching Phase4FX's offline <0.1ms measurement closely once isolated). This is a soft/preferred target, not a mandatory gate, and is dwarfed by actual generation latency (mean 3.32s / 3320ms across the 95 production generations in this phase — i.e. entity-attribution overhead is <0.2% of total request latency). No second LLM call is used anywhere in this integration, consistent with the requirement.
optimization_note: if the ~5ms figure needs to be brought under the preferred threshold, the straightforward fix (not implemented in this phase, out of scope per Section3's 'no improvisation' — flagged for future consideration only) would be a small in-process cache of get_all_chunks(machine_id) results, since the single-machine DB's chunk set does not change between ingests. Not required for CASE determination given generation dominates total latency by 3 orders of magnitude.
gate_verdict: PASS (soft target near-met; no mandatory performance gate violated; no second LLM call)
